regions.today: Dry this evening with sunny spells. Winds will generally be light and northerly, but will be easterly for a time in coastal areas.
regions.tonight: It will be dry for much of tonight with some clear spells. Cloud will spread from the north later, with patchy light rain and drizzle developing towards dawn. Lowest temperatures of 5 to 8 degrees in light to moderate westerly winds.
regions.tomorrow: Mostly cloudy at first tomorrow, with some patchy light rain. The rain will clear to the south during the morning and the rest of the day will be dry with sunny spells. Becoming breezy, with moderate or fresh west to northwesterly winds developing. Highest temperatures of 14 to 17 degrees.
